summary:
Conan often gets into a lot of danger. Gets kidnapped, drowned, buried in snow, dropped off high places, gets shot at or stabbed. Gets beat up. Or just gets sick often.
It must be really hard on Kogoro and Ran.
That being said. I wanted to explore the hurt/comfort and aftermath the show and Manga don't often show.
